enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Place arm under pillow. Shift legs. Sleep. Turn onto back. Move arm. Turn onto side. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and morning hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Close cabinet. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Place plate on table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing work bag for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Open drawer. Take out underwear. Put on underwear. Close drawer. Pick up work bag. Open bag. Insert laptop. Insert stethoscope. Close bag. Pick up keys. Pick up phone. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to facility.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter facility. Greet colleagues. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Attend patient 1. Take vitals. Administer medication. Update records. Attend patient 2. Perform procedure. Consult with doctor. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Attend patient 3. Write reports. Attend meeting. Clean equipment. Wash hands. Change out of scrubs.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Close cabinet. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Stir. Add meat. Add spices. Cook. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Eat dinner. Clear dishes. Wash dishes.

Enter living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Get up. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Return to sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer for personal tasks and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit at desk. Open computer. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Open browser. Check email. Reply to emails. Open document. Write report. Save document. Open social media. Scroll. Close browser. Open game. Play game. Save game. Close game. Shut down computer. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to other side. Shift legs. Continue sleeping. Wake briefly. Turn over. Sleep.
